description: Drafts and reviews software docs using The Good Docs Project templates and guides — picks the right content type (README, how-to, tutorial, concept, reference, release notes, API docs, community docs, and more), then fills it from real project facts. Add Google-style docstrings to this function, args/returns/raises, don't change the logic:

def apply_discount(invoice, code, now=None):
    now = now or datetime.utcnow()
    promo = PROMOS.get(code)
    if promo is None or promo.expires < now:
        raise InvalidPromo(code)
    invoice.total = round(invoice.total * (1 - promo.rate), 2)
    return invoice
